subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Pin Joints and Sliders: Building Blocks
description: Learn Pin Joints and Sliders: Building Blocks in one minute.

hook.text: Every mechanism is built from just a few joint types. Two dominate.

buildup.text: A pin joint lets two links rotate around a shared axis — like a hinge.

discovery.text: A slider joint lets a link slide along a straight path. Pistons use it.

twist.text: Combining just pins and sliders produces nearly all common mechanisms.

climax.text: Car engines, landing gear, and folding chairs all use pin-and-slider combos.

punchline.text: Two joint types build a million machines.

quiz.question: What motion does a slider joint allow?
options: Linear sliding along a straight path
